impact.text: Vault backing/surplus accounting and monitoring are unavailable while the stale slot remains registered.

precondition_sources.text: The Vault has an Accountant configured.
There is no active registration for the target BLP slot before the operator calls supplyToBlp.

intent_sources.text: supplyToBlp must call notifyVaultSupply only after verifying the supplied slot is readable and active.
If HyperCore activation can be asynchronous, registration must remain pending and be promoted only after a successful suppliedBalance read.
